title: Count The Number of Winning Sequences
sources: https://leetcode.com/problems/count-the-number-of-winning-sequences/ (official page returns 403 to fetch; link from web search)
accessAttempt: Constraints and two examples from the doocs mirror (paraphrased); the mirror's explanation for FFF was checked by hand.
summary: Alice's moves are given; count Bob's sequences of F/W/E (no move repeated in consecutive rounds) with strictly more points than Alice, modulo 1e9+7.
officialConstraints: s[i] is F, W, or E
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps s at 10 characters; solver is O(n^2).
